a.xlink:title: Converts a std::chrono duration to scheduler ticks, rounding up.
Delays the calling task for a std::chrono duration, rounded up to whole ticks.
Delays the calling task until a fixed std::chrono period after its previous wake time.
Locks the mutex, blocking the calling task for up to the given duration.
Reconfigures the sensor debounce and switch-timeout durations.
Reconfigures the rotation time.
Synchronizes several tasks at a common rendezvous point, with a duration timeout.
Takes the semaphore, blocking the calling task for at most the given duration.
Blocks the calling task until the notification value is non-zero, with a std::chrono timeout.
Blocks until the requested bits are set or the timeout duration expires.
Blocks the calling task until a notification is received, with a std::chrono timeout.
Blocks the task that called start() until the next edge is captured.
Blocks the task that called start() until the counter next matches the compare value.
Blocks the calling task until any of the given bits is set, with a std::chrono timeout.
Blocks the task that called start() until the next period completes.
Blocks the task that called start() until the next pulse starts, i.e.
Binds the cylinder name, off/on position sensors, and output, and configures timing parameters.
Copy construction is disabled; the cylinder is bound to a single output and a pair of sensor inputs.
Copy assignment is disabled; the cylinder is bound to a single output and a pair of sensor inputs.
Binds the cylinder name and output, and configures the rotation timing.
Copy assignment is disabled; the cylinder is bound to a single output.
Copy construction is disabled; the cylinder is bound to a single output.
